## Mooncalf (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
CE Large aberration (mythos)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsight 100 ft., darkvision 120 ft., night vision; Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +8 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 132 (12d8+36)  
**Fort** +9; **Ref** +7; **Will** +9  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 120 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** bite +14 (2d6+7/19–20/×3), 2 tentacles +13 (1d6+5 plus grab), feeder arms +13 (1d6+2)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (20 ft. with tentacles)  
**Special Attacks** feeder arms, severing bite  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 16, **Con** 16, **Int** 13, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +15 (+19 grapple, +19 trip); **CMD** 28 (30 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Combat Expertise, Great Fortitude, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Trip, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +18, Fly +12, Intimidate +15, Perception +16, Stealth +14  
**Languages** Aklo (cannot speak), telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** no breath  


**Special Abilities**


**Feeder Arms (Ex)** A mooncalf can transfer a grappled victim from a tentacle to its feeder arms as a move action. The feeder arms grapple with the same strength as the creature’s tentacles but deal less damage.
